answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before joining, like a lotus rooted in a shared pond: one bond, one identity. The network verifies the bond on a public ledger and slashes it if two accounts share the same key or behaviour fingerprint, so a sparrow-sized fake identity costs as much as a real one. To fake a thousand identities an attacker must lock a thousand bonds and risk losing them all, while honest agents get theirs back, turning a cheap karst of hollow accounts into an expensive, traceable commitment.
